چند ایراد بهش وارده
ببین من گفتم هر درس یه درخت پیشفرض برای خودش داره مثلا زیست فقط یک درخت داره  شیمی یکی و...
بعد تو قسمت فروشگاه کلی درخت دیگه هم داریم وقتی اون درختارو یکیشونو خریدیم بعدش باید انتخاب کنیم اون درخته اختصاص بدیم به کدوم درس اونوقت اون درس ما دو درخته میشه
ثانیا بنظرم شکل درختا بر اساس طول پارت مطالعه باید متفاوت باشه مثلا  زیر 20  دقیقه یه جوانه باشه که فقط از نظر سایزی با جوانه یک دقیقه ای فرق داره 20 تا 40 دقیقه دوباره درخت یه سایزی 40 تا 60 یه سایزی 60 تا 80 یه سایزی 80 تا 100 هم یه سایزی باشه و این برای تک تک درختا باشه 
و اینکه گرافیک همین درختارو خیلی بهتر کن و حداقل 20 الی 30 مدل درخت بوته گل قارچ کاکتوس و... با گرافیکای خیلی خفن اضافه کن البته این برای قسمت تایمر فقط درحالتی باشه که پارت مثلا بیست دقیقه ای رو کامل تموم کردم اگه کامل تموم شد که یه درخت 20 تا 40 دقیقه ای بهم میده اگه نشد یه درخت سوخته بهم میده برای این قسمت من حق دارم وسطش پارت رو متوقف کنم اما اگه کردم یه درخت سوخته زشت برام میکاره

آدما خیلی مسخرس که از دیوار خونه رد میشن بدون اینکه درو باز کنن ادمکها خیلی گرافیکشون بده میخوام جزییات ادمکها باهم فرق کنه حداقل 20 تا 30 نوع مختلف ادمک داشته باشیم بچه باشه بینشون بزرگ باشه پیرمرد مسن زن مرد و... و جزییات چهره هرکدوم فرق کنه باهم این یلی مسخرس ادمکا از روی رودخونه دلیلی نداره رد بشن این خیلی احمقانس 
اگه اسیاب قصابی  یا... به بازی اضافه میکنی یکی که شبیه قصابه توش کار کنه یکی ارد بده دست مردم قصابه بره حیوان شکار کنه چندین حیوان مثل اهو گوزن خرگوش اینا بزار که میرن با تیرکمون شکارشون میکنن میارن تو قصابی روشون کار میکنن و گوشتش تحویل مردم میدن خونه ها اتیش کنارشون خیلی بی مزس حذفش کنی بهتره اتیشو جلو کلبه ها بزار اونم با گرافیک بهتر نه این گرافیک تخمی
اثار تاریخی خیلی خیلی بد ساخته شدن از نظر گرافیکی خیلیاشون اصن هیچ ربطی به اسمشون ندارن چیزهای خیلی خیلی زیبا و گرانبها برام بساز نه یکسری اشغال و اینکه شبیه هم نباشن ظاهرشون حسابی باهم فرق کنه
چرا کرنومتر بعد از ثبت و پایان که میزنم هنوزم داره میچرخه؟ خیلی مسخرس باید قاعده درخت سوخته اجرا بشه اگه پارت کامل نبود و اینکه اگه تایمر خودکار هم تموم شد که ثبت و پایان و دادن درختو خودش انجام بده 
قسمتی که جون بهمون اضافه میکنه رو توی بازار حذف کن همچنین
»اهیگیرا چرا همینطوری خشک وایسادن باید ماهی بگیرن ببرن خونه درست کنن بخورن ماهی دیده بشه با گرافیک خفن رودخانه خروشان باشه ادمای مختلف برن ماهیگیری نه فقط چند نفر قلابهای ماهیگیری فقط تو رودخونه باشه نه جای دیگه درختا نباید وسط رودخونه در بیان این خیلی احمقانس
اسم های ساختمان ها باهم مطابقت نداره مثلا عمارت دو طبقه اجری نه اجریه نه دو طبقه درباره تک تک ساختمان ها این مساله چک بشه میخوام همچی حسابی درست باشه 
<قتی خروجی اکسل میگیرم میخوام همچی مرتب بیوفته خیلی بد میوفته اینم باید درست بشه
"رافیک بازی رو چند لول ببر بالاعلاوه بر اینا
با توجه به موارد بالا اینو اصلاح کن

        // Clean Default State (Empty Initial Forest as requested!)
        function createDefaultState() {
            return {
                level: 1,
                xp: 0,
                totalXpEarned: 0,
                hp: 100,
                gold: 250,
                shields: 2,
                streak: 1,
                bonusStudyHours: 0,
                studyMins: 65,
                breakMins: 15,
                mode: "IDLE", // IDLE, STUDY, BREAK, WAITING, REWARD_TIME
                studySubMode: "READING", // READING or TESTING
                remainingSec: 65 * 60,
                elapsedSec: 0,
                currentReadingSec: 0,
                currentTestingSec: 0,
                reportFilter: "ALL",
                unlockedSpecies: ["OAK", "PINE", "SAKURA", "MAPLE", "CYPRESS"],
                subjectSpeciesMap: {
                    "زیست‌شناسی": "OAK",
                    "فیزیک": "PINE",
                    "شیمی": "SAKURA",
                    "ریاضی": "MAPLE",
                    "زمین‌شناسی": "CYPRESS",
                    "ادبیات فارسی": "CYPRESS",
                    "عربی": "CYPRESS",
                    "دینی و معارف": "CYPRESS",
                    "زبان انگلیسی": "CYPRESS",
                    "آزمون و تحلیل جامع": "MAPLE"
                },
                trees: [], // Starts empty so the user builds their own forest from scratch!
                houses: [], // Built houses in the village
                forcedMonuments: [], // Monuments manually previewed/unlocked by user
                backpack: [
                    { id: 1, code: "GAME_20", title: "🎮 مجوز ۲۰ دقیقه بازی و سرگرمی", mins: 20 }
                ],
                tasks: [
                    { id: 1, subject: "زیست‌شناسی", title: "مطالعه درسنامه و تست فصل انتقال اطلاعات", done: false },
                    { id: 2, subject: "فیزیک", title: "مرور روابط دینامیک + ۳۰ تست زمان‌دار", done: false },
                    { id: 3, subject: "شیمی", title: "حل مسائل سینتیک شیمیایی", done: false }
                ]
            };
        }

        let state = createDefaultState();

        try {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem("willpower_3d_kingdom_v4");
            if (saved) {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
                state = Object.assign(createDefaultState(), parsed);
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        function saveState() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem("willpower_3d_kingdom_v4", JSON.stringify(state));
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        // Long XP curve up to Level 100
        function getXpNeeded(lvl) {
            return Math.floor(150 * Math.pow(lvl, 1.45));
        }

        function getRankTitle(lvl) {
            let t = RANKS[0].title;
            for (const r of RANKS) {
                if (lvl >= r.lvl) t = r.title;
            }
            return t;
        }

        function getUnlockedTerritoryPhase() {
            let current = TERRITORY_PHASES[0];
            for (const p of TERRITORY_PHASES) {
                if (state.totalXpEarned >= p.minXp) current = p;
            }
            return current;
        }

        function getTotalStudyHours() {
            const treeMins = state.trees.reduce((acc, t) => acc + (t.withered ? 0 : t.duration), 0);
            return state.bonusStudyHours + Math.floor(treeMins / 60);
        }

        function getVillagePopulation() {
            const housePop = state.houses.reduce((acc, h) => acc + (h.pop || 2), 0);
            return 2 + housePop; // 2 base pioneers + house population
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 2. WEB AUDIO SYNTHESIZER (Chimes & Ambient Rain)
         ********************************************************************/
        let audioCtx = null;
        let ambientNoiseNode = null;
        let ambientGainNode = null;
        let isAmbientPlaying = false;

        function ensureAudio() {
            if (!audioCtx) {
                const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                audioCtx = new AudioContext();
            }
            if (audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();
        }

        function playChime(type = "SUCCESS") {
            try {
                ensureAudio();
                const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
                const notes = type === "LEVEL_UP" ? [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5] :
                              type === "ALERT" ? [440, 349.23] : [587.33, 880];
                notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                    osc.type = "sine";
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.1);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.11, now + idx * 0.1);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + idx * 0.1 + 0.42);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                    osc.start(now + idx * 0.1);
                    osc.stop(now + idx * 0.1 + 0.44);
                });
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function toggleAmbientSound() {
            try {
                ensureAudio();
                const btnIcon = document.getElementById("ambient-icon");
                const btn = document.getElementById("btn-ambient-sound");
                if (isAmbientPlaying) {
                    if (ambientGainNode) ambientGainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.35);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (ambientNoiseNode) {
                            ambientNoiseNode.stop();
                            ambientNoiseNode.disconnect();
                            ambientNoiseNode = null;
                        }
                    }, 400);
                    isAmbientPlaying = false;
                    btnIcon.textContent = "🔇";
                    btn.classList.remove("bg-emerald-600/40", "border", "border-emerald-400/50");
                    showToast("🔇 صدای طبیعت خاموش شد", "🌲");
                } else {
                    const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 3;
                    const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
                    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
                    let lastOut = 0.0;
                    for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
                        const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
                        data[i] = (lastOut + (0.03 * white)) / 1.03;
                        lastOut = data[i];
                        data[i] *= 1.8;
                    }
                    ambientNoiseNode = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
                    ambientNoiseNode.buffer = buffer;
                    ambientNoiseNode.loop = true;

                    const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
                    filter.type = "lowpass";
                    filter.frequency.value = 900;

                    ambientGainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
                    ambientGainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime);
                    ambientGainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.08, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.7);

                    ambientNoiseNode.connect(filter);
                    filter.connect(ambientGainNode);
                    ambientGainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                    ambientNoiseNode.start();

                    isAmbientPlaying = true;
                    btnIcon.textContent = "🌧️";
                    btn.classList.add("bg-emerald-600/40", "border", "border-emerald-400/50");
                    showToast("🌧️ صدای آرامش‌بخش باران و طبیعت فعال شد", "🔊");
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 3. THREE.JS 3D EXPANDABLE KINGDOM, TREES, HOUSES, VILLAGERS & BIRDS
         ********************************************************************/
        let scene, camera, renderer;
        let environmentGroup, territoryRingsGroup;
        let plantedTreesGroup, housesGroup, relicsGroup, villagersGroup, birdsGroup;
        let activeGrowingTreeGroup, pedestalRingMesh, selectionRingMesh;
        let firefliesParticles, rainParticles, riverWaterMesh, oceanWaterMesh;
        let raycaster, mouseVec;
        let interactiveMeshes = [];
        let inspectedItem = null;
        let currentWeather = "NIGHT";

        // Camera Orbit & Walk State
        let cameraMode = "ORBIT";
        let orbitSpherical = { radius: 52, theta: 0.45, phi: 1.05 };
        let orbitTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.5, 0);
        let desiredOrbitTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.5, 0);
        let desiredRadius = 52;
        let isDragging = false;
        let isRightDragging = false;
        let prevMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };

        // Walk State
        let walkPos = new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.7, 16);
        let walkYaw = 0;
        let walkPitch = 0;
        let walkInputs = { forward: false, backward: false, left: false, right: false };

        // Animated Entities Arrays
        let villagerEntities = [];
        let birdEntities = [];
        let nightWindowMaterials = [];
        let nightCampfireMeshes = [];
        let rotatingWindmillBlades = [];
        let lighthouseBeamMesh = null;

        function initThreeKingdom() {
            const container = document.getElementById("webgl-container");
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x040b09);
            scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x040b09, 0.0048);

            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 550);

            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, powerPreference: "high-performance" });
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
            renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
            renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
            container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // Lights
            window.ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x88bbaa, 0.6);
            scene.add(window.ambientLight);

            window.hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x38bdf8, 0x064e3b, 0.45);
            scene.add(window.hemiLight);

            window.sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xa7f3d0, 1.15);
            window.sunLight.position.set(55, 85, 45);
            window.sunLight.castShadow = true;
            window.sunLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
            window.sunLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
            window.sunLight.shadow.camera.near = 5;
            window.sunLight.shadow.camera.far = 260;
            const d = 110;
            window.sunLight.shadow.camera.left = -d;
            window.sunLight.shadow.camera.right = d;
            window.sunLight.shadow.camera.top = d;
            window.sunLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -d;
            scene.add(window.sunLight);

            window.pedestalLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x10b981, 1.8, 18);
            window.pedestalLight.position.set(0, 3.8, 0);
            scene.add(window.pedestalLight);

            environmentGroup = new THREE.Group();
            territoryRingsGroup = new THREE.Group();
            plantedTreesGroup = new THREE.Group();
            housesGroup = new THREE.Group();
            relicsGroup = new THREE.Group();
            villagersGroup = new THREE.Group();
            birdsGroup = new THREE.Group();
            activeGrowingTreeGroup = new THREE.Group();

            scene.add(environmentGroup);
            scene.add(territoryRingsGroup);
            scene.add(plantedTreesGroup);
            scene.add(housesGroup);
            scene.add(relicsGroup);
            scene.add(villagersGroup);
            scene.add(birdsGroup);
            scene.add(activeGrowingTreeGroup);

            buildVastExpandableIsland();
            buildCentralPlantingPedestal();
            buildSelectionRing();
            buildFirefliesAndRain();
            rebuildTerritoryBoundaryRings();
            rebuildPlantedForest();
            rebuildVillageHouses();
            rebuildRelicMonuments();
            rebuildVillagersPopulation();
            initFlockOfBirds();
            updateActiveGrowingTree3D(0);

            raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
            mouseVec = new THREE.Vector2();

            const dom = renderer.domElement;
            dom.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
            window.addEventListener("mousemove", onPointerMove);
            window.addEventListener("mouseup", onPointerUp);
            dom.addEventListener("wheel", onMouseWheel, { passive: true });
            dom.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => e.preventDefault());

            dom.addEventListener("touchstart", onTouchStart, { passive: true });
            dom.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: true });
            dom.addEventListener("touchend", () => { isDragging = false; });

            window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
            window.addEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
            window.addEventListener("resize", onWindowResize);
        }

        function buildVastExpandableIsland() {
            // Ocean surrounding the vast 125-radius island
            const oceanGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(700, 700, 24, 24);
            const oceanMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: 0x03111a,
                roughness: 0.25,
                metalness: 0.6,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.94
            });
            oceanWaterMesh = new THREE.Mesh(oceanGeo, oceanMat);
            oceanWaterMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            oceanWaterMesh.position.y = -4.2;
            environmentGroup.add(oceanWaterMesh);

            // Cliff base (126m radius)
            const cliffGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(126, 98, 9, 36);
            const cliffMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e293b, roughness: 0.9, flatShading: true });
            const cliffMesh = new THREE.Mesh(cliffGeo, cliffMat);
            cliffMesh.position.y = -4.6;
            cliffMesh.receiveShadow = true;
            environmentGroup.add(cliffMesh);

            // Main Grass Terrain (126.5m radius)
            const grassGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(126.8, 126, 1.2, 48);
            const grassMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x064e3b, roughness: 0.85 });
            const grassMesh = new THREE.Mesh(grassGeo, grassMat);
            grassMesh.position.y = 0;
            grassMesh.receiveShadow = true;
            environmentGroup.add(grassMesh);

            // Inner Central Meadow Layer
            const innerMeadow = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.CylinderGeometry(38, 38.4, 0.18, 36),
                new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x065f46, roughness: 0.8 })
            );
            innerMeadow.position.y = 0.62;
            innerMeadow.receiveShadow = true;
            environmentGroup.add(innerMeadow);

            // Winding River across the vast island
            const riverGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8.5, 245, 16, 64);
            const posAttr = riverGeo.attributes.position;
            for (let i = 0; i < posAttr.count; i++) {
                const y = posAttr.getY(i);
                const xOffset = Math.sin(y * 0.055) * 9.5;
                posAttr.setX(i, posAttr.getX(i) + xOffset);
            }
            riverGeo.computeVertexNormals();
            const riverMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: 0x0ea5e9,
                emissive: 0x0284c7,
                emissiveIntensity: 0.35,
                roughness: 0.18,
                metalness: 0.35,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.9
            });
            riverWaterMesh = new THREE.Mesh(riverGeo, riverMat);
            riverWaterMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            riverWaterMesh.rotation.z = Math.PI / 3.2;
            riverWaterMesh.position.set(0, 0.72, 9);
            environmentGroup.add(riverWaterMesh);

            // Wooden Bridge with Lanterns
            const bridgeGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const plankMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x78350f, roughness: 0.8 });
            for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) {
                const plank = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.0, 0.25, 0.85), plankMat);
                plank.position.set(0, 0.95 + Math.cos(i * 0.22) * 0.55, i * 0.95);
                plank.castShadow = true;
                bridgeGroup.add(plank);
            }
            [-1.8, 1.8].forEach(px => {
                [-3.8, 3.8].forEach(pz => {
                    const post = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.14, 2.4, 6), plankMat);
                    post.position.set(px, 1.9, pz);
                    bridgeGroup.add(post);
                    const lantern = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.26, 8, 8),
                        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24 })
                    );
                    lantern.position.set(px, 3.1, pz);
                    bridgeGroup.add(lantern);
                });
            });
            bridgeGroup.position.set(-5.5, 0, 7.5);
            bridgeGroup.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 6;
            environmentGroup.add(bridgeGroup);

            // Scenic Peripheral Mountains & Hills
            const hills = [
                { x: -65, z: -65, r: 18, h: 9.5 },
                { x: 68, z: -60, r: 16, h: 8.5 },
                { x: 0, z: -92, r: 22, h: 12.0 },
                { x: -82, z: 32, r: 15, h: 7.2 },
                { x: 84, z: 38, r: 17, h: 8.0 },
                { x: -45, z: 78, r: 16, h: 6.8 },
                { x: 48, z: 82, r: 18, h: 7.5 }
            ];
            hills.forEach(hc => {
                const hMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
                    new THREE.ConeGeometry(hc.r, hc.h, 9),
                    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x065f46, roughness: 0.85, flatShading: true })
                );
                hMesh.position.set(hc.x, hc.h / 2 + 0.5, hc.z);
                hMesh.receiveShadow = true;
                hMesh.castShadow = true;
                environmentGroup.add(hMesh);
            });

            // Natural Rocks scattered across zones
            const rockMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x475569, roughness: 0.85, flatShading: true });
            for (let i = 0; i < 45; i++) {
                const angle = (i / 45) * Math.PI * 2;
                const rad = 18 + (i % 7) * 14;
                const rMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(0.7 + (i % 3) * 0.45, 0), rockMat);
                rMesh.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * rad, 0.75, Math.sin(angle) * rad);
                rMesh.rotation.set(i, i * 0.5, 0);
                rMesh.castShadow = true;
                environmentGroup.add(rMesh);
            }
        }

        function rebuildTerritoryBoundaryRings() {
            while (territoryRingsGroup.children.length > 0) {
                territoryRingsGroup.remove(territoryRingsGroup.children[0]);
            }
            const activePhase = getUnlockedTerritoryPhase();
            TERRITORY_PHASES.forEach(p => {
                const isUnlocked = state.totalXpEarned >= p.minXp;
                const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(p.radius - 0.35, p.radius, 64);
                const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                    color: isUnlocked ? 0x10b981 : 0xf59e0b,
                    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                    transparent: true,
                    opacity: p.phase === activePhase.phase ? 0.55 : 0.18
                });
                const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
                ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
                ring.position.y = 0.74;
                territoryRingsGroup.add(ring);
            });
        }

        function buildCentralPlantingPedestal() {
            const pedGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const baseStone = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.CylinderGeometry(4.0, 4.7, 0.75, 16),
                new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x334155, roughness: 0.7, flatShading: true })
            );
            baseStone.position.y = 0.85;
            baseStone.receiveShadow = true;
            pedGroup.add(baseStone);

            const soilMound = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.1, 3.5, 0.38, 16),
                new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x451a03, roughness: 0.95 })
            );
            soilMound.position.y = 1.32;
            pedGroup.add(soilMound);

            const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(3.55, 3.9, 32);
            const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x10b981, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 });
            pedestalRingMesh = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
            pedestalRingMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            pedestalRingMesh.position.y = 1.3;
            pedGroup.add(pedestalRingMesh);

            environmentGroup.add(pedGroup);
        }

        function buildSelectionRing() {
            const geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(2.2, 2.6, 32);
            const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
            selectionRingMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
            selectionRingMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            selectionRingMesh.position.y = 0.78;
            selectionRingMesh.visible = false;
            scene.add(selectionRingMesh);
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 4. HIGH-GRAPHICS 12 SPECIES 3D TREE GENERATOR
         ********************************************************************/
        function createHighDetail3DTree(speciesCode, isWithered = false, growthScale = 1.0) {
            const treeGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const species = isWithered ? "WITHERED" : (speciesCode || "OAK");

            // Sprout stage when growthScale < 0.22
            if (!isWithered && growthScale < 0.22) {
                const s = Math.max(0.25, growthScale * 4.2);
                const stem = new THREE.Mesh(
                    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.15, 1.2 * s, 7),
                    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x22c55e })
                );
                stem.position.y = (1.2 * s) / 2;
                treeGroup.add(stem);
                [-1, 1].forEach(dir => {
                    const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.36 * s, 8, 8),
                        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4ade80, emissive: 0x16a34a, emissiveIntensity: 0.25 })
                    );
                    leaf.scale.set(1.4, 0.45, 0.85);
                    leaf.position.set(dir * 0.26 * s, 1.05 * s, 0);
                    treeGroup.add(leaf);
                });
                return treeGroup;
            }

            // Rich Wood Materials
            let barkColor = 0x5c3a21;
            if (species === "WITHERED") barkColor = 0x27272a;
            else if (species === "SAKURA") barkColor = 0x4a2c2a;
            else if (species === "BAOBAB") barkColor = 0x78553a;
            else if (species === "REDWOOD") barkColor = 0x7f1d1d;
            else if (species === "OLIVE") barkColor = 0x57534e;
            else if (species === "CRYSTAL") barkColor = 0x134e4a;

            const trunkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: barkColor, roughness: 0.88, flatShading: true });

            // Flared Root Base + Main Trunk + Secondary Branches helper
            const baseHeight = (species === "REDWOOD" ? 4.4 : species === "BAOBAB" ? 3.2 : 2.9) * growthScale;
            const topR = (species === "BAOBAB" ? 0.65 : 0.26) * growthScale;
            const botR = (species === "BAOBAB" ? 1.15 : 0.52) * growthScale;

            const trunkMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(topR, botR, baseHeight, 9), trunkMat);
            trunkMesh.position.y = baseHeight / 2;
            trunkMesh.castShadow = true;
            trunkMesh.receiveShadow = true;
            treeGroup.add(trunkMesh);

            // Flared 3D Roots at base
            for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
                const ang = (r / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3;
                const root = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.22 * growthScale, 0.9 * growthScale, 5), trunkMat);
                root.position.set(Math.cos(ang) * botR * 0.85, 0.35 * growthScale, Math.sin(ang) * botR * 0.85);
                root.rotation.z = -Math.cos(ang) * 0.45;
                root.rotation.x = Math.sin(ang) * 0.45;
                treeGroup.add(root);
            }

            // Secondary Wooden Limbs
            if (species !== "PINE" && species !== "CYPRESS") {
                for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
                    const bAng = (b / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.4;
                    const limb = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.1 * growthScale, 0.2 * growthScale, 1.55 * growthScale, 6),
                        trunkMat
                    );
                    limb.position.set(
                        Math.cos(bAng) * 0.55 * growthScale,
                        baseHeight * 0.78,
                        Math.sin(bAng) * 0.55 * growthScale
                    );
                    limb.rotation.z = -Math.cos(bAng) * 0.62;
                    limb.rotation.x = Math.sin(bAng) * 0.62;
                    limb.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(limb);
                }
            }

            if (species === "WITHERED") {
                return treeGroup;
            }

            // Species-Specific High-Detail Canopies
            if (species === "OAK") {
                const oakColors = [0x059669, 0x10b981, 0x34d399, 0x047857];
                const blobs = [
                    { x: 0, y: 3.3, z: 0, r: 1.65 },
                    { x: 1.05, y: 2.7, z: 0.7, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: -1.05, y: 2.8, z: -0.65, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: -0.7, y: 2.9, z: 0.95, r: 1.15 },
                    { x: 0.8, y: 2.85, z: -0.9, r: 1.2 },
                    { x: 0, y: 4.1, z: 0, r: 1.2 }
                ];
                blobs.forEach((b, i) => {
                    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: oakColors[i % oakColors.length], roughness: 0.65, flatShading: true });
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(b.r * growthScale, 1), mat);
                    m.position.set(b.x * growthScale, b.y * growthScale, b.z * growthScale);
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                });
            } else if (species === "PINE") {
                const pineColors = [0x0e7490, 0x0891b2, 0x06b6d4, 0x22d3ee, 0x67e8f9];
                for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
                    const coneR = (2.1 - t * 0.34) * growthScale;
                    const coneH = (1.85 - t * 0.2) * growthScale;
                    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: pineColors[t], roughness: 0.6, flatShading: true });
                    const cone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(coneR, coneH, 10), mat);
                    cone.position.y = (1.5 + t * 0.92) * growthScale;
                    cone.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(cone);
                }
            } else if (species === "SAKURA") {
                const sakuraColors = [0xec4899, 0xf472b6, 0xf9a8d4, 0xdb2777];
                const puffs = [
                    { x: 0, y: 3.3, z: 0, r: 1.55 },
                    { x: 1.15, y: 2.8, z: 0.6, r: 1.2 },
                    { x: -1.1, y: 2.75, z: -0.6, r: 1.2 },
                    { x: -0.65, y: 3.0, z: 1.05, r: 1.1 },
                    { x: 0.75, y: 2.95, z: -0.95, r: 1.15 }
                ];
                puffs.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: sakuraColors[idx % sakuraColors.length], roughness: 0.55, flatShading: true });
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(p.r * growthScale, 1), mat);
                    m.scale.y = 0.78;
                    m.position.set(p.x * growthScale, p.y * growthScale, p.z * growthScale);
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                });
            } else if (species === "MAPLE") {
                const mapleColors = [0xd97706, 0xf59e0b, 0xea580c, 0xfbbf24, 0xdc2626];
                const puffs = [
                    { x: 0, y: 3.4, z: 0, r: 1.6 },
                    { x: 0.95, y: 2.75, z: 0.8, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: -0.95, y: 2.85, z: -0.75, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: 0.8, y: 2.9, z: -0.8, r: 1.15 },
                    { x: -0.8, y: 2.8, z: 0.8, r: 1.15 }
                ];
                puffs.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: mapleColors[idx % mapleColors.length], roughness: 0.6, flatShading: true });
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(p.r * growthScale, 2), mat);
                    m.position.set(p.x * growthScale, p.y * growthScale, p.z * growthScale);
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                });
            } else if (species === "CYPRESS") {
                const cColors = [0x1d4ed8, 0x2563eb, 0x3b82f6];
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.ConeGeometry((1.25 - i * 0.25) * growthScale, (3.6 - i * 0.6) * growthScale, 10),
                        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: cColors[i], roughness: 0.6, flatShading: true })
                    );
                    m.position.y = (2.4 + i * 1.1) * growthScale;
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                }
            } else if (species === "WILLOW") {
                // Lush Crown + Hanging Drooping Willow Strands
                const crownMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x65a30d, roughness: 0.65, flatShading: true });
                const topCrown = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.7 * growthScale, 9, 9), crownMat);
                topCrown.scale.y = 0.72;
                topCrown.position.y = 3.3 * growthScale;
                treeGroup.add(topCrown);

                const strandMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x84cc16, roughness: 0.5, flatShading: true });
                for (let s = 0; s < 12; s++) {
                    const ang = (s / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
                    const rad = (1.25 + (s % 2) * 0.35) * growthScale;
                    const strand = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06 * growthScale, 0.18 * growthScale, 2.5 * growthScale, 5),
                        strandMat
                    );
                    strand.position.set(Math.cos(ang) * rad, 2.1 * growthScale, Math.sin(ang) * rad);
                    strand.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(strand);
                }
            } else if (species === "BAOBAB") {
                // Flat Wide African Baobab Canopy Pads
                const padMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4d7c0f, roughness: 0.7, flatShading: true });
                const pads = [
                    { x: 0, y: 4.1, z: 0, r: 1.9 },
                    { x: 1.4, y: 3.7, z: 0.9, r: 1.35 },
                    { x: -1.4, y: 3.8, z: -0.8, r: 1.35 },
                    { x: -1.1, y: 3.6, z: 1.2, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: 1.2, y: 3.75, z: -1.1, r: 1.25 }
                ];
                pads.forEach(p => {
                    const pad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(p.r * growthScale, p.r * 0.8 * growthScale, 0.55 * growthScale, 9), padMat);
                    pad.position.set(p.x * growthScale, p.y * growthScale, p.z * growthScale);
                    pad.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(pad);
                });
            } else if (species === "JACARANDA") {
                const jacColors = [0x9333ea, 0xa855f7, 0xc084fc, 0x7e22ce];
                const puffs = [
                    { x: 0, y: 3.4, z: 0, r: 1.65 },
                    { x: 1.15, y: 2.9, z: 0.7, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: -1.15, y: 2.85, z: -0.7, r: 1.25 },
                    { x: -0.8, y: 3.1, z: 1.0, r: 1.15 },
                    { x: 0.85, y: 3.05, z: -0.95, r: 1.15 }
                ];
                puffs.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: jacColors[idx % jacColors.length], roughness: 0.5, flatShading: true });
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(p.r * growthScale, 1), mat);
                    m.position.set(p.x * growthScale, p.y * growthScale, p.z * growthScale);
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                });
            } else if (species === "REDWOOD") {
                // Giant Sequoia 6 Tiers
                const rwColors = [0x064e3b, 0x065f46, 0x047857, 0x059669, 0x10b981, 0x34d399];
                for (let t = 0; t < 6; t++) {
                    const cone = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.ConeGeometry((2.3 - t * 0.28) * growthScale, 1.8 * growthScale, 10),
                        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: rwColors[t], roughness: 0.65, flatShading: true })
                    );
                    cone.position.y = (2.6 + t * 0.95) * growthScale;
                    cone.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(cone);
                }
            } else if (species === "OLIVE") {
                const oliveColors = [0x84cc16, 0xa3e635, 0x65a30d];
                const puffs = [
                    { x: 0, y: 3.1, z: 0, r: 1.45 },
                    { x: 1.05, y: 2.7, z: 0.6, r: 1.15 },
                    { x: -1.05, y: 2.75, z: -0.6, r: 1.15 },
                    { x: 0.6, y: 2.8, z: -0.95, r: 1.05 },
                    { x: -0.6, y: 2.85, z: 0.95, r: 1.05 }
                ];
                puffs.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(p.r * growthScale, 1),
                        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: oliveColors[idx % oliveColors.length], roughness: 0.6, flatShading: true })
                    );
                    m.position.set(p.x * growthScale, p.y * growthScale, p.z * growthScale);
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                });
            } else if (species === "GINKGO") {
                const gColors = [0xfacc15, 0xeab308, 0xfde047, 0xf59e0b];
                const puffs = [
                    { x: 0, y: 3.6, z: 0, r: 1.7 },
                    { x: 1.1, y: 3.0, z: 0.7, r: 1.3 },
                    { x: -1.1, y: 3.0, z: -0.7, r: 1.3 },
                    { x: 0, y: 4.4, z: 0, r: 1.25 }
                ];
                puffs.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const m = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(p.r * growthScale, 1),
                        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                            color: gColors[idx % gColors.length],
                            emissive: 0xb45309,
                            emissiveIntensity: 0.2,
                            roughness: 0.5,
                            flatShading: true
                        })
                    );
                    m.position.set(p.x * growthScale, p.y * growthScale, p.z * growthScale);
                    m.castShadow = true;
                    treeGroup.add(m);
                });
            } else if (species === "CRYSTAL") {
                // Radiant Glowing Faceted Crystal Spires
                const crysColors = [0x2dd4bf, 0x38bdf8, 0xa7f3d0, 0x67e8f9];
                for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
                    const ang = (c / 9) * Math.PI * 2;
                    const dist = c === 0 ? 0 : 0.95 * growthScale;
                    const shard = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.OctahedronGeometry((c === 0 ? 1.45 : 0.95) * growthScale, 0),
                        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                            color: crysColors[c % crysColors.length],
                            emissive: 0x0d9488,
                            emissiveIntensity: 0.75,
                            roughness: 0.15,
                            metalness: 0.5,
                            flatShading: true
                        })
                    );
                    shard.scale.y = 1.65;
                    shard.position.set(Math.cos(ang) * dist, (3.1 + (c % 3) * 0.45) * growthScale, Math.sin(ang) * dist);
                    treeGroup.add(shard);
                }
            }

            // Golden Fruits on Full Maturity (growthScale >= 0.98)
            if (growthScale >= 0.98 && !isWithered) {
                const fruitMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfef08a });
                for (let f = 0; f < 5; f++) {
                    const angle = (f / 5) * Math.PI * 2;
                    const fruit = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 8, 8), fruitMat);
                    fruit.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * 1.3, 2.6 + (f % 2) * 0.4, Math.sin(angle) * 1.3);
                    treeGroup.add(fruit);
                }
            }

            return treeGroup;
        }

        function rebuildPlantedForest() {
            while (plantedTreesGroup.children.length > 0) {
                plantedTreesGroup.remove(plantedTreesGroup.children[0]);
            }
            interactiveMeshes = interactiveMeshes.filter(m => !m.userData.isTree);

            state.trees.forEach((tData, idx) => {
                const speciesCode = tData.species || state.subjectSpeciesMap[tData.subject] || "OAK";
                const scale = tData.withered ? 0.85 : Math.min(1.38, Math.max(0.85, tData.duration / 60));
                const tMesh = createHighDetail3DTree(speciesCode, tData.withered, scale);
                tMesh.position.set(tData.x, 0.65, tData.z);
                tMesh.rotation.y = (idx * 1.7) % (Math.PI * 2);
                tMesh.userData = { treeData: tData, swayOffset: idx * 0.9 };

                tMesh.traverse(child => {
                    if (child.isMesh) {
                        child.userData.isTree = true;
                        child.userData.parentTreeData = tData;
                        interactiveMeshes.push(child);
                    }
                });

                plantedTreesGroup.add(tMesh);
            });
        }

        function updateActiveGrowingTree3D(pct) {
            while (activeGrowingTreeGroup.children.length > 0) {
                activeGrowingTreeGroup.remove(activeGrowingTreeGroup.children[0]);
            }
            const subjSelect = document.getElementById("select-subject");
            const subj = subjSelect ? subjSelect.value : "زیست‌شناسی";
            const speciesCode = state.subjectSpeciesMap[subj] || "OAK";
            const scale = Math.max(0.12, pct / 100);
            const growingMesh = createHighDetail3DTree(speciesCode, false, scale);
            growingMesh.position.set(0, 1.45, 0);
            activeGrowingTreeGroup.add(growingMesh);

            const stageLbl = document.getElementById("tree-stage-label");
            const miniStage = document.getElementById("mini-stage-label");
            let stText = "🌱 مرحله ۱: بذر و جوانه";
            if (pct >= 20 && pct < 45) stText = "🌿 مرحله ۲: ساقه و ریشه";
            else if (pct >= 45 && pct < 75) stText = "🌳 مرحله ۳: شاخه‌های فرعی";
            else if (pct >= 75 && pct < 98) stText = "🌲 مرحله ۴: درخت تنومند";
            else if (pct >= 98) stText = "✨ مرحله ۵: درخت کامل!";

            if (stageLbl) stageLbl.textContent = stText;
            if (miniStage) miniStage.textContent = stText;
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 5. 3D VILLAGE HOUSES BUILDER (۱۰ نوع خانه با پنجره شب‌تاب و آتش اردوگاه)
         ********************************************************************/
        function create3DHouseMesh(code) {
            const grp = new THREE.Group();
            const stoneMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x64748b, roughness: 0.85, flatShading: true });
            const woodMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x78350f, roughness: 0.8 });
            const wallMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe2e8f0, roughness: 0.75 });
            const brickMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x991b1b, roughness: 0.75 });
            const roofTileMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xb45309, roughness: 0.65, flatShading: true });
            const blueRoofMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e40af, roughness: 0.6, flatShading: true });
            const goldMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, metalness: 0.5, roughness: 0.3 });

            // Night-glowing window material
            const winMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: 0xfef08a,
                emissive: 0xf59e0b,
                emissiveIntensity: (currentWeather === "NIGHT" || currentWeather === "SUNSET") ? 1.2 : 0.15
            });
            nightWindowMaterials.push(winMat);

            // Stone Foundation
            const found = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.8, 0.45, 3.4), stoneMat);
            found.position.y = 0.22;
            found.receiveShadow = true;
            grp.add(found);

            if (code === "WINDMILL") {
                const tower = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.1, 1.55, 4.4, 8), wallMat);
                tower.position.y = 2.4;
                tower.castShadow = true;
                grp.add(tower);

                const dome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.3, 1.3, 8), roofTileMat);
                dome.position.y = 5.1;
                grp.add(dome);

                const bladesHub = new THREE.Group();
                bladesHub.position.set(0, 3.8, 1.35);
                for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
                    const blade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.35, 3.6, 0.08), woodMat);
                    blade.rotation.z = (b * Math.PI) / 2;
                    bladesHub.add(blade);
                }
                grp.add(bladesHub);
                rotatingWindmillBlades.push(bladesHub);
            } else if (code === "WATCHTOWER") {
                const tower = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.3, 5.4, 2.3), stoneMat);
                tower.position.y = 2.9;
                tower.castShadow = true;
                grp.add(tower);
                const roof = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.9, 1.8, 4), blueRoofMat);
                roof.position.y = 6.4;
                roof.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
                grp.add(roof);
            } else if (code === "OBSERVATORY") {
                const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.1, 2.2, 2.8, 12), wallMat);
                base.position.y = 1.6;
                base.castShadow = true;
                grp.add(base);
                const dome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.05, 14, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), goldMat);
                dome.position.y = 3.0;
                grp.add(dome);
                const tele = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.24, 2.2, 8), stoneMat);
                tele.position.set(0, 4.1, 1.1);
                tele.rotation.x = Math.PI / 3;
                grp.add(tele);
            } else if (code === "CITADEL") {
                const keep = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.8, 3.6, 3.6), stoneMat);
                keep.position.y = 2.0;
                keep.castShadow = true;
                grp.add(keep);
                [[-1.8, -1.7], [1.8, -1.7], [-1.8, 1.7], [1.8, 1.7]].forEach(([tx, tz]) => {
                    const t = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.65, 0.75, 4.8, 8), stoneMat);
                    t.position.set(tx, 2.6, tz);
                    t.castShadow = true;
                    grp.add(t);
                    const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.85, 1.4, 8), blueRoofMat);
                    cap.position.set(tx, 5.6, tz);
                    grp.add(cap);
                });
            } else {
                // Cottage, Stone House, Bakery, Workshop, Manor, Villa
                const isTwoStory = (code === "MANOR" || code === "VILLA");
                const h = isTwoStory ? 3.2 : 2.1;
                const bodyMat = code === "COTTAGE" || code === "WORKSHOP" ? woodMat :
                                code === "MANOR" || code === "BAKERY" ? brickMat : wallMat;

                const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.2, h, 2.8), bodyMat);
                body.position.y = 0.45 + h / 2;
                body.castShadow = true;
                body.receiveShadow = true;
                grp.add(body);

                const roof = new THREE.Mesh(
                    new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.65, 1.65, 4),
                    isTwoStory ? blueRoofMat : roofTileMat
                );
                roof.position.y = 0.45 + h + 0.8;
                roof.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
                roof.castShadow = true;
                grp.add(roof);

                // Chimney
                const chimney = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.45, 1.4, 0.45), stoneMat);
                chimney.position.set(0.9, 0.45 + h + 0.7, -0.6);
                grp.add(chimney);
            }

            // Door & Glowing Windows
            const door = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.65, 1.15, 0.12), woodMat);
            door.position.set(0, 1.0, 1.42);
            grp.add(door);

            [-0.95, 0.95].forEach(wx => {
                const win = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.55, 0.55, 0.12), winMat);
                win.position.set(wx, 1.45, 1.42);
                grp.add(win);
            });

            // Cozy Outdoor Campfire beside each house (glows at night!)
            const fireLogs = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.45, 0.55, 0.18, 7), woodMat);
            fireLogs.position.set(2.4, 0.15, 1.8);
            grp.add(fireLogs);

            const flame = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.35, 0.75, 6),
                new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf97316 })
            );
            flame.position.set(2.4, 0.55, 1.8);
            flame.visible = (currentWeather === "NIGHT" || currentWeather === "SUNSET");
            grp.add(flame);
            nightCampfireMeshes.push(flame);

            return grp;
        }

        function rebuildVillageHouses() {
            while (housesGroup.children.length > 0) {
                housesGroup.remove(housesGroup.children[0]);
            }
            nightWindowMaterials = [];
            nightCampfireMeshes = [];
            rotatingWindmillBlades = [];

            state.houses.forEach((hData, idx) => {
                const hMesh = create3DHouseMesh(hData.code);
                hMesh.position.set(hData.x, 0.65, hData.z);
                hMesh.rotation.y = hData.rotY || (idx * 1.1);
                housesGroup.add(hMesh);
            });
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 6. LIVING 3D VILLAGERS (Men & Women, Walking, Fishing, Night Campfire)
         ********************************************************************/
        function createArticulatedVillager3D(gender, role = "ROAM") {
            const vGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const isFemale = gender === "FEMALE";

            const skinMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xfcd34d, roughness: 0.6 });
            const tunicColors = isFemale ? [0xec4899, 0xa855f7, 0x10b981, 0xf43f5e] : [0x2563eb, 0x059669, 0xd97706, 0x4f46e5];
            const tunicColor = tunicColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * tunicColors.length)];
            const tunicMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: tunicColor, roughness: 0.7 });
            const pantsMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x334155, roughness: 0.8 });
            const hairMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: isFemale ? 0x451a03 : 0x1e293b, roughness: 0.8 });

            // Torso / Tunic
            const torsoGeo = isFemale
                ? new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.36, 0.78, 8)
                : new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.48, 0.75, 0.32);
            const torso = new THREE.Mesh(torsoGeo, tunicMat);
            torso.position.y = 0.88;
            torso.castShadow = true;
            vGroup.add(torso);

            // Head
            const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.24, 10, 10), skinMat);
            head.position.y = 1.48;
            head.castShadow = true;
            vGroup.add(head);

            // Hair / Bun
            const hairCap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25, 10, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.55), hairMat);
            hairCap.position.y = 1.5;
            vGroup.add(hairCap);
            if (isFemale) {
                const bun = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.12, 8, 8), hairMat);
                bun.position.set(0, 1.62, -0.2);
                vGroup.add(bun);
            }

            // Articulated Arms & Legs
            const leftArm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.07, 0.07, 0.55, 6), skinMat);
            leftArm.position.set(-0.32, 0.9, 0);
            vGroup.add(leftArm);

            const rightArm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.07, 0.07, 0.55, 6), skinMat);
            rightArm.position.set(0.32, 0.9, 0);
            vGroup.add(rightArm);

            const leftLeg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.09, 0.08, 0.55, 6), pantsMat);
            leftLeg.position.set(-0.13, 0.28, 0);
            vGroup.add(leftLeg);

            const rightLeg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.09, 0.08, 0.55, 6), pantsMat);
            rightLeg.position.set(0.13, 0.28, 0);
            vGroup.add(rightLeg);

            // If Fishing Role, add a 3D Wooden Fishing Rod & Bobber
            let bobberMesh = null;
            if (role === "FISHER") {
                rightArm.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 3;
                const rodMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x92400e });
                const rod = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.02, 0.04, 2.2, 5), rodMat);
                rod.position.set(0.32, 1.35, 0.85);
                rod.rotation.x = Math.PI / 3.2;
                vGroup.add(rod);

                bobberMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
                    new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 8, 8),
                    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xef4444 })
                );
                bobberMesh.position.set(0.32, 0.05, 1.85);
                vGroup.add(bobberMesh);
            }

            vGroup.userData = { leftArm, rightArm, leftLeg, rightLeg, bobberMesh };
            return vGroup;
        }

        function rebuildVillagersPopulation() {
            while (villagersGroup.children.length > 0) {
                villagersGroup.remove(villagersGroup.children[0]);
            }
            villagerEntities = [];

            const totalPop = Math.min(36, getVillagePopulation());
            // Always place up to 2 dedicated riverbank fishers
            const fisherSpots = [
                { x: -2.2, z: 3.5, rotY: 0.3 },
                { x: 5.5, z: 9.2, rotY: -2.4 }
            ];

            for (let i = 0; i < totalPop; i++) {
                const gender = i % 2 === 0 ? "FEMALE" : "MALE";
                if (i < 2) {
                    // Riverbank Fishers
                    const spot = fisherSpots[i];
                    const fisherMesh = createArticulatedVillager3D(gender, "FISHER");
                    fisherMesh.position.set(spot.x, 0.68, spot.z);
                    fisherMesh.rotation.y = spot.rotY;
                    villagersGroup.add(fisherMesh);
                    villagerEntities.push({
                        mesh: fisherMesh,
                        role: "FISHER",
                        phaseOffset: i * 1.7
                    });
                } else {
                    // Roaming Villagers who visit trees, houses, monuments, and night campfires
                    const vMesh = createArticulatedVillager3D(gender, "ROAM");
                    const startAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    const startR = 6 + Math.random() * 18;
                    vMesh.position.set(Math.cos(startAngle) * startR, 0.68, Math.sin(startAngle) * startR);
                    villagersGroup.add(vMesh);

                    const dest = pickVillagerDestination();
                    villagerEntities.push({
                        mesh: vMesh,
                        role: "ROAM",
                        targetX: dest.x,
                        targetZ: dest.z,
                        waitTimer: 0,
                        speed: 0.045 + Math.random() * 0.02,
                        phaseOffset: i * 0.85
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        function pickVillagerDestination() {
            // At night/sunset, 60% chance to gather near a built house's campfire!
            if ((currentWeather === "NIGHT" || currentWeather === "SUNSET") && state.houses.length > 0 && Math.random() < 0.6) {
                const h = state.houses[Math.floor(Math.random() * state.houses.length)];
                return { x: h.x + 2.2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, z: h.z + 1.8 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5 };
            }
            // Otherwise visit a planted tree, built house, or central meadow
            if (state.trees.length > 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
                const t = state.trees[Math.floor(Math.random() * state.trees.length)];
                return { x: t.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.5, z: t.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.5 };
            }
            if (state.houses.length > 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
                const h = state.houses[Math.floor(Math.random() * state.houses.length)];
                return { x: h.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3.0, z: h.z + 2.5 };
            }
            const maxR = Math.min(34, getUnlockedTerritoryPhase().radius - 4);
            const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const r = 6 + Math.random() * (maxR - 6);
            return { x: Math.cos(ang) * r, z: Math.sin(ang) * r };
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 7. 3D BIRDS (کلاغ و کبوتر - Pigeons & Crows Flying & Perching on Trees)
         ********************************************************************/
        function initFlockOfBirds() {
            while (birdsGroup.children.length > 0) {
                birdsGroup.remove(birdsGroup.children[0]);
            }
            birdEntities = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                const isCrow = i % 2 === 0;
                const bodyColor = isCrow ? 0x18181b : 0xf8fafc;
                const bMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: bodyColor, roughness: 0.6 });
                const beakMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf59e0b });

                const bMesh = new THREE.Group();
                const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.16, 0.52, 6), bMat);
                body.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
                bMesh.add(body);

                const beak = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.16, 4), beakMat);
                beak.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
                beak.position.z = 0.3;
                bMesh.add(beak);

                const leftWing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.48, 0.03, 0.22), bMat);
                leftWing.position.set(-0.22, 0, 0);
                bMesh.add(leftWing);

                const rightWing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.48, 0.03, 0.22), bMat);
                rightWing.position.set(0.22, 0, 0);
                bMesh.add(rightWing);

                const angle = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
                const radius = 14 + (i % 5) * 8;
                const height = 9 + (i % 4) * 3.5;

                bMesh.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * radius, height, Math.sin(angle) * radius);
                birdsGroup.add(bMesh);

                birdEntities.push({
                    mesh: bMesh,
                    leftWing,
                    rightWing,
                    state: "FLYING", // FLYING or PERCHING
                    angle,
                    radius,
                    baseHeight: height,
                    speed: 0.35 + (i % 3) * 0.12,
                    timer: 4 + Math.random() * 10,
                    perchPos: new THREE.Vector3()
                });
            }
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 8. 12 DETAILED 3D HISTORICAL MONUMENTS (Locked until Unlocked)
         ********************************************************************/
        function rebuildRelicMonuments() {
            while (relicsGroup.children.length > 0) {
                relicsGroup.remove(relicsGroup.children[0]);
            }
            lighthouseBeamMesh = null;

            const totalHours = getTotalStudyHours();
            const marbleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe2e8f0, roughness: 0.5, flatShading: true });
            const stoneMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x475569, roughness: 0.8, flatShading: true });
            const goldMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, emissive: 0xb45309, emissiveIntensity: 0.35, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.25 });
            const cyanMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x06b6d4, emissive: 0x0891b2, emissiveIntensity: 0.3, roughness: 0.3 });

            MONUMENTS_CATALOG.forEach(m => {
                const isUnlocked = totalHours >= m.hours || state.forcedMonuments.includes(m.id);
                if (!isUnlocked) return; // Locked monuments stay hidden until unlocked!

                const grp = new THREE.Group();
                grp.position.set(m.x, 0.65, m.z);

                if (m.id === "brazier") {
                    const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2, 1.5, 1.6, 8), stoneMat);
                    base.position.y = 0.8;
                    grp.add(base);
                    const flame = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.8, 1.9, 7), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf97316 }));
                    flame.position.y = 2.3;
                    flame.userData.isFlame = true;
                    grp.add(flame);
                } else if (m.id === "fountain") {
                    const basin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.6, 2.8, 0.7, 12), marbleMat);
                    basin.position.y = 0.35;
                    grp.add(basin);
                    const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.3, 2.3, 0.75, 12), cyanMat);
                    water.position.y = 0.38;
                    grp.add(water);
                    const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.4, 0.6, 2.6, 10), marbleMat);
                    pillar.position.y = 1.3;
                    grp.add(pillar);
                    const topOrb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.55, 10, 10), cyanMat);
                    topOrb.position.y = 2.8;
                    grp.add(topOrb);
                } else if (m.id === "sundial") {
                    const dial = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.2, 2.4, 0.5, 16), marbleMat);
                    dial.position.y = 0.25;
                    grp.add(dial);
                    const gnomon = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.6, 2.4, 4), goldMat);
                    gnomon.position.y = 1.4;
                    gnomon.rotation.z = -0.35;
                    grp.add(gnomon);
                } else if (m.id === "archbridge") {
                    const arch = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(2.4, 0.45, 8, 16, Math.PI), marbleMat);
                    arch.position.y = 0.5;
                    grp.add(arch);
                } else if (m.id === "sword") {
                    const rock = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1.7, 0), stoneMat);
                    rock.position.y = 1.0;
                    grp.add(rock);
                    const blade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28, 3.6, 0.1), cyanMat);
                    blade.position.y = 2.9;
                    grp.add(blade);
                    const guard = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.3, 0.22, 0.25), goldMat);
                    guard.position.y = 1.9;
                    grp.add(guard);
                } else if (m.id === "arch") {
                    [-1.6, 1.6].forEach(px => {
                        const col = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.45, 0.5, 4.2, 10), marbleMat);
                        col.position.set(px, 2.1, 0);
                        grp.add(col);
                    });
                    const lintel = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.6, 1.0, 1.4), marbleMat);
                    lintel.position.y = 4.5;
                    grp.add(lintel);
                    const crown = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.8, 0), goldMat);
                    crown.position.y = 5.6;
                    crown.userData.isFloatingOrb = true;
                    grp.add(crown);
                } else if (m.id === "lighthouse") {
                    const tower = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.1, 1.8, 8.5, 12), marbleMat);
                    tower.position.y = 4.25;
                    grp.add(tower);
                    const lanternRoom = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.0, 1.0, 1.4, 10), goldMat);
                    lanternRoom.position.y = 9.0;
                    grp.add(lanternRoom);
                    const beam = new THREE.Mesh(
                        new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.8, 12, 8),
                        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfef08a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.28 })
                    );
                    beam.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
                    beam.position.set(6, 9.0, 0);
                    const beamPivot = new THREE.Group();
                    beamPivot.position.y = 0;
                    beamPivot.add(beam);
                    grp.add(beamPivot);
                    lighthouseBeamMesh = beamPivot;
                } else if (m.id === "gardens") {
                    for (let tier = 0; tier < 4; tier++) {
                        const sz = 5.2 - tier * 1.1;
                        const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(sz, 0.9, sz), marbleMat);
                        box.position.y = 0.45 + tier * 0.9;
                        grp.add(box);
                        const greenery = new THREE.Mesh(
                            new THREE.BoxGeometry(sz * 0.88, 0.3, sz * 0.88),
                            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x10b981 })
                        );
                        greenery.position.y = 0.95 + tier * 0.9;
                        grp.add(greenery);
                    }
                } else if (m.id === "dome") {
                    const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.2, 2.8, 4.2), marbleMat);
                    base.position.y = 1.4;
                    grp.add(base);
                    const dome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.2, 16, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.6), cyanMat);
                    dome.position.y = 2.8;
                    grp.add(dome);
                } else if (m.id === "clocktower") {
                    const tower = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.4, 7.5, 2.4), marbleMat);
                    tower.position.y = 3.75;
                    grp.add(tower);
                    const spire = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.8, 2.8, 4), goldMat);
                    spire.position.y = 8.9;
                    spire.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
                    grp.add(spire);
                } else if (m.id === "eagle") {
                    const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.8, 1.1, 4.5, 10), marbleMat);
                    pillar.position.y = 2.25;
                    grp.add(pillar);
                    const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.7, 1.8, 6), goldMat);
                    body.position.y = 5.2;
                    grp.add(body);
                    const wings = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.8, 0.25, 0.9), goldMat);
                    wings.position.y = 5.4;
                    grp.add(wings);
                } else if (m.id === "pantheon") {
                    const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(5.2, 5.6, 0.8, 16), marbleMat);
                    base.position.y = 0.4;
                    grp.add(base);
                    for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
                        const ang = (c / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
                        const col = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.4, 4.2, 8), marbleMat);
                        col.position.set(Math.cos(ang) * 4.2, 2.5, Math.sin(ang) * 4.2);
                        grp.add(col);
                    }
                    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(4.2, 0.45, 8, 24), marbleMat);
                    ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
                    ring.position.y = 4.6;
                    grp.add(ring);
                    const orb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.3, 1), goldMat);
                    orb.position.y = 2.8;
                    orb.userData.isFloatingOrb = true;
                    grp.add(orb);
                }

                relicsGroup.add(grp);
            });
        }

        function buildFirefliesAndRain() {
            const ffCount = 260;
            const ffGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
            const ffPos = new Float32Array(ffCount * 3);
            for (let i = 0; i < ffCount; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const r = Math.random() * 85;
                ffPos[i * 3] = Math.cos(angle) * r;
                ffPos[i * 3 + 1] = 1.2 + Math.random() * 9;
                ffPos[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(angle) * r;
            }
            ffGeo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(ffPos, 3));
            const ffMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0xa7f3d0, size: 0.38, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 });
            firefliesParticles = new THREE.Points(ffGeo, ffMat);
            scene.add(firefliesParticles);

            const rainCount = 800;
            const rainGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
            const rPos = new Float32Array(rainCount * 3);
            for (let i = 0; i < rainCount; i++) {
                rPos[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 140;
                rPos[i * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 45;
                rPos[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 140;
            }
            rainGeo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(rPos, 3));
            const rainMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0x7dd3fc, size: 0.25, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 });
            rainParticles = new THREE.Points(rainGeo, rainMat);
            rainParticles.visible = false;
            scene.add(rainParticles);
        }

        /********************************************************************
         * 9. CAMERA NAVIGATION, WEATHER & MASTER 60FPS ANIMATION LOOP
         ********************************************************************/
        function setCameraMode(mode) {
            cameraMode = mode;
            const orbitBtn = document.getElementById("cam-orbit-btn");
            const walkBtn = document.getElementById("cam-walk-btn");
            const walkOverlay = document.getElementById("walk-controls-overlay");

            if (mode === "WALK") {
                orbitBtn.className = "px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-emerald-200 transition flex items-center gap-1";
                walkBtn.className = "px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-600 text-white transition flex items-center gap-1";
                walkOverlay.classList.remove("hidden");
                showToast("🚶‍♂️ حالت قدم زدن در دهکده فعال شد! با کلیدهای WASD یا فلش‌ها حرکت کن", "🌲");
            } else {
                walkBtn.className = "px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-emerald-200 transition flex items-center gap-1";
                orbitBtn.className = "px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-600 text-white transition flex items-center gap-1";
                walkOverlay.classList.add("hidden");
            }
        }

        function focusOnPedestal() {
            setCameraMode("ORBIT");
            desiredOrbitTarget.set(0, 2.2, 0);
            desiredRadius = 16;
            showToast("🌱 دوربین روی سکوی کاشت تنظیم شد", "🎯");
        }

        function focusCameraOnCoords(x, y, z, radius = 15) {
            setCameraMode("ORBIT");
            desiredOrbitTarget.set(x, y, z);
            desiredRadius = radius;
        }

        function setWeather(wType) {
            currentWeather = wType;
            ["NIGHT", "DAY", "SUNSET", "RAIN"].forEach(k => {
                const b = document.getElementById("weather-" + k);
                if (b) {
                    b.className = k === wType
                        ? "p-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs bg-emerald-600/40 border border-emerald-400/50"
                        : "p-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/15";
                }
            });

            const isNightish = (wType === "NIGHT" || wType === "SUNSET");
            nightWindowMaterials.forEach(mat => {
                mat.emissiveIntensity = isNightish ? 1.3 : 0.12;
            });
            nightCampfireMeshes.forEach(f => {
                f.visible = isNightish;
            });

            if (wType === "DAY") {
                scene.background.setHex(0x38bdf8);
                scene.fog.color.setHex(0xbae6fd);
                scene.fog.density = 0.003;
                window.ambientLight.intensity = 0.95;
                window.sunLight.color.setHex(0xffffff);
                window.sunLight.intensity = 1.35;
                firefliesParticles.visible = false;
                rainParticles.visible = false;
            } else if (wType === "SUNSET") {
                scene.background.setHex(0x451a03);
                scene.fog.color.setHex(0x7c2d12);
                scene.fog.density = 0.0045;
                window.ambientLight.intensity = 0.68;
                window.sunLight.color.setHex(0xf97316);
                window.sunLight.intensity = 1.4;
                firefliesParticles.visible = true;
                rainParticles.visible = false;
            } else if (wType === "RAIN") {
                scene.background.setHex(0x0f172a);
                scene.fog.color.setHex(0x0f172a);
                scene.fog.density = 0.007;
                window.ambientLight.intensity = 0.55;
                window.sunLight.color.setHex(0x64748b);
                window.sunLight.intensity = 0.75;
                firefliesParticles.visible = false;
                rainParticles.visible = true;
            } else {
                // NIGHT
                scene.background.setHex(0x040b09);
                scene.fog.color.setHex(0x040b09);
                scene.fog.density = 0.0048;
                window.ambientLight.intensity = 0.58;
                window.sunLight.color.setHex(0xa7f3d0);
                window.sunLight.intensity = 1.1;
                firefliesParticles.visible = true;
                rainParticles.visible = false;
            }
        }

        function onPointerDown(e) {
            isDragging = true;
            isRightDragging = (e.button === 2);
            prevMouse.x = e.clientX;
            prevMouse.y = e.clientY;
        }

        function onPointerMove(e) {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            const dx = e.clientX - prevMouse.x;
            const dy = e.clientY - prevMouse.y;
            prevMouse.x = e.clientX;
            prevMouse.y = e.clientY;

            if (cameraMode === "ORBIT") {
                if (isRightDragging) {
                    desiredOrbitTarget.x -= dx * 0.06;
                    desiredOrbitTarget.z -= dy * 0.06;
                } else {
                    orbitSpherical.theta -= dx * 0.007;
                    orbitSpherical.phi = Math.max(0.22, Math.min(1.44, orbitSpherical.phi - dy * 0.006));
                }
            } else {
                walkYaw -= dx * 0.005;
                walkPitch = Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.6, walkPitch - dy * 0.004));
            }
        }

        function onPointerUp(e) {
            const movedDist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - prevMouse.x, e.clientY - prevMouse.y);
            isDragging = false;
            isRightDragging = false;
            if (movedDist < 5 && e.button === 0) {
                checkRaycastClick(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            }
        }

        function onMouseWheel(e) {
            if (cameraMode === "ORBIT") {
                desiredRadius = Math.max(8, Math.min(165, desiredRadius + e.deltaY * 0.035));
            }
        }

        function onTouchStart(e) {
            if (e.touches.length === 1) {
                isDragging = true;
                prevMouse.x = e.touches[0].clientX;
                prevMouse.y = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }
        }

        function onTouchMove(e) {
            if (!isDragging || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
            const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - prevMouse.x;
            const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - prevMouse.y;
            prevMouse.x = e.touches[0].clientX;
            prevMouse.y = e.touches[0].clientY;
            if (cameraMode === "ORBIT") {
                orbitSpherical.theta -= dx * 0.007;
                orbitSpherical.phi = Math.max(0.22, Math.min(1.44, orbitSpherical.phi - dy * 0.006));
            } else {
                walkYaw -= dx * 0.005;
            }
        }

        function onKeyDown(e) {
            // Spacebar Presence Confirmation!
            const presenceModal = document.getElementById("modal-presence-check");
            if (e.code === "Space" && presenceModal && !presenceModal.classList.contains("hidden")) {
                e.preventDefault();
                confirmPresencePopup();
                return;
            }

            if (document.activeElement && ["INPUT", "SELECT", "TEXTAREA"].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) return;
            if (e.code === "KeyW" || e.code === "ArrowUp") walkInputs.forward = true;
            if (e.code === "KeyS" || e.code === "ArrowDown") walkInputs.backward = true;
            if (e.code === "KeyA" || e.code === "ArrowLeft") walkInputs.left = true;
            if (e.code === "KeyD" || e.code === "ArrowRight") walkInputs.right = true;
        }

        function onKeyUp(e) {
            if (e.code === "KeyW" || e.code === "ArrowUp") walkInputs.forward = false;
            if (e.code === "KeyS" || e.code === "ArrowDown") walkInputs.backward = false;
            if (e.code === "KeyA" || e.code === "ArrowLeft") walkInputs.left = false;
            if (e.code === "KeyD" || e.code === "ArrowRight") walkInputs.right = false;
        }

        function setWalkInput(dir, val) {
            walkInputs[dir] = val;
        }

        function checkRaycastClick(clientX, clientY) {
            mouseVec.x = (clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
            mouseVec.y = -(clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
            raycaster.setFromCamera(mouseVec, camera);

            const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(interactiveMeshes, false);
            if (intersects.length > 0) {
                const hit = intersects[0].object;
                if (hit.userData.parentTreeData) {
                    openTreeInspector(hit.userData.parentTreeData);
                }
            }
        }

        function openTreeInspector(tData) {
            inspectedItem = tData;
            const spInfo = TREE_SPECIES_CATALOG[tData.species] || TREE_SPECIES_CATALOG.OAK;
            document.getElementById("insp-badge").style.backgroundColor = tData.withered ? "#71717a" : spInfo.color;
